title: Competitive Price Targeting with Smartphone Coupons
authors: Jean‐Pierre Dubé; Zheng Fang; Nathan M. Fong; Xueming Luo
eligible_reason: No DiD. Randomized field experiment that simultaneously randomizes mobile-coupon prices of two competing movie theaters (geo/behavioral targeting arms), followed by a probit demand system and Bertrand-Nash equilibrium pricing simulations. No pre/post panel regression with unit and time FE.
design_notes: Package: demand_estim.R (multinomial probit demand by simulated ML), ProbitPricing_Equilibrium.R (equilibrium prices, best-response plots). Regression inventory empty.
data_files_note: README: estimsample.Rdata 'contains simulated purchases generated by a model with the same estimated parameters as in the paper'.
data_provenance_note: Simulated purchases from the estimated model (README).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from README, code and OpenAlex abstract.
